name: Naruse Rei
source:
Code name: Zero.
Quick learner, has a serious personality and takes every mission seriously.
His five senses are sharper than others especially his hearing and he
can easily see through the behavioral pattern of his enemies.

He goes to the same school as the heroine and is in the same grade, but due to his activities at night with Ark he is always tired due to lack of sleep.
